name: clipboard-type
title: Clipboard Type
description: Type out your clipboard as keystrokes where pasting is blocked, like web forms and remote desktop sessions.
author: krishna_bhanushali

commands.name: type-clipboard
commands.title: Type Clipboard
commands.description: Type the current clipboard text as keystrokes.

preferences.name: humanCadenceSpeed
preferences.title: Typing Speed
preferences.description: How fast to type. Times are averages for ordinary characters. Capitals and symbols take longer. Use a slower speed if characters are dropped in remote desktops or browser-based consoles.

preferences.name: humanCadence
preferences.label: Human Cadence
preferences.description: Randomly vary the pause between keystrokes to mimic human typing. The average typing speed stays the same.

preferences.name: softNewlines
preferences.label: Soft Newlines (Shift+Enter)
preferences.description: Use Shift+Enter for newlines instead of Enter. Useful for apps and websites that treat Enter as submit.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
